llm_raw_reply: With a ₹12 LPA salary you should be able to apply for all the cards shown – SBI Cashback, Axis Flipkart, HSBC Cashback, Kiwi Klick and SBI Simply Click.
final_reply: With a ₹12 LPA salary you’re likely eligible for all the cards shown – SBI Cashback, Axis Flipkart, HSBC Cashback, Kiwi Klick and SBI Simply Click. They each have low or no joining fees and the benefits line up with everyday spend like dining, online shopping and travel. You can apply directly for any of these, though the exact approval will depend on the bank’s own checks.
